title: Crane Point Museum

services.name: Fish Pedicure
services.desc: Have you ever wanted to get a fish pedicure? Now you can. It’s FREE with admission to Crane Point. Dip your toes in the tidal pool located near the Point and let these minnows nibble on your feet. They will emerge shiny and new, and look like you just had a professional pedicure. With your support, we can continue to educate residents and visitors about the natural and cultural history of the area.
